task.description: Decide whether an outgoing museum loan is ready to ship. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_security, resolve_environment, resolve_light, resolve_offgassing, resolve_insurance, resolve_handling, or ready.

timeline.author: collections_system
timeline.content: Outgoing-loan shipment review for Amara Weber; readiness decision pending.

timeline.author: Carlos Mensah
timeline.content:
- Because Amara Weber believes the board is blaming them personally for the failed request to fund overnight security, Amara Weber has been watching this part of the loan especially closely, and the facility provides security only during opening hours.
- The security office is piloting a new venue-review form and has chosen Amara Weber's institution for the pilot, so I would rather return this file on security until the pilot review is signed off.
- Carlos Mensah has started taking evening classes toward a career change.
- Carlos Mensah's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Tariq Meyer
timeline.content:
- Because the climate-control project was designed with a late mentor of Amara Weber, and they still see its performance as part of that mentor's legacy, Amara Weber has been pressing for attention to this issue, even as the gallery is stable at 68°F and 45% relative humidity.
- Tariq Meyer's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.
- Tariq Meyer is considering reducing their working hours because of responsibilities at home.

timeline.author: Jamie Kowalski
timeline.content:
- The display location measures a maximum of 5 footcandles, with no direct natural light.
- Jamie Kowalski is on a debt-repayment plan after several months of missed bills.
- Jamie Kowalski's partner recently lost their job and the household is relying on one income.

timeline.author: Felix Dubois
timeline.content:
- Amara Weber has been especially preoccupied with this part of the loan because the fabricator is an old classmate of Amara Weber, who feels awkward asking them to change anything once a schedule has been agreed, and new materials will have off-gassed for 28 days before installation.
- Our framework renewal is scored on installations completed in their booked week, and Amara Weber's installation is one of the jobs used in that metric, so a shipment delay would count against us and I would prefer it to proceed on schedule.
- Felix Dubois is on a debt-repayment plan after several months of missed bills.
- Felix Dubois has been interviewing for another job.

timeline.author: Jonas Santos
timeline.content:
- The loan is covered under the Smithsonian's policy, with the premium invoiced to the borrower.
- Jonas Santos's partner recently lost their job and the household is relying on one income.

timeline.author: Rafael Ibrahim
timeline.content:
- Experienced professional personnel will handle, pack and transport the objects, and Amara Weber has been giving that finding extra weight because Amara Weber dropped a crate during a student job two decades ago and still becomes tense whenever they watch an unpacking.
- Our transport team has to close two more routine vendor audits before year-end, and the haulier proposed for Amara Weber's shipment is next in the rotation, so I would rather hold the file on handling until that audit is finished.
- Our transport unit is measured on supervising-courier bookings, and adding one to Amara Weber's shipment would put the team over its annual target, so I would rather send the case back on handling and require that service.
- Rafael Ibrahim owes a close friend money and is embarrassed about the delay in repaying it.
- Rafael Ibrahim is caring for a parent with dementia.

timeline.author: Amara Weber
timeline.content: - Amara Weber owes a close friend money and is embarrassed about the delay in repaying it.

timeline.author: collections_system
timeline.content: - Internal Audit selected Amara Weber's loan file because borrower-supplied light measurements were the most common reason files were reopened after a ready decision last year, so the audit team wants an additional light review on this case.

timeline.author: collections_system
timeline.content:
OUTGOING LOAN REVIEW
To: Ingrid Chen
Decide whether the outgoing loan to Amara Weber's institution is ready to ship. Check security, environmental conditions, light, off-gassing, insurance and professional handling. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_security, resolve_environment, resolve_light, resolve_offgassing, resolve_insurance, resolve_handling, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.
